finish_lines.name: FinanceMeta
finish_lines.target: Launch-ready member platform with verified participation and persistence
evidence: Open issue #19 records a confirmed authorization defect where a member-controlled profile role can plausibly escalate privileges.
Issue #19 also records missing canonical CI, inadequate real tests, broken E2E wiring and unverified production Supabase/golden-journey evidence.
A guarded hardening artifact exists, but target-repository application and production certification are not verified.
blockers: Target repository write access and production Supabase evidence are unavailable to the current connected control plane
finish_lines.next_action: Apply the authorization hardening in an isolated target branch, add denial-path tests and a canonical release gate, then certify production with disposable member/admin accounts.

finish_lines.name: The Bu1LD
finish_lines.target: Launch-ready institution and member platform ending in a reviewed contribution
evidence: Merged PR #82 independently certified the immutable Bu1LD source release gate with 152 tests and 435 assertions, typecheck, lint and client/SSR builds.
Merged PR #75 verified eight public HTTP routes but explicitly did not certify hydration or authenticated behavior.
Open issue #84 records a reproduced React hydration error and repository/deployment skew; open issue #16 requires production Supabase and role-journey certification.
blockers: Production Supabase and Cloudflare evidence unavailable
finish_lines.next_action: Identify the exact deployed immutable source/build, repair the hydration/deployment skew, rerun the public browser gate, then execute issue #16 role journeys.

Production identifies one immutable build and the strict desktop/mobile browser certification passes without hydration errors or source/deployment skew.
